# Sikh University

> A free, open online university teaching Sikhi (Sikh theology, history,
> philosophy, language, spirituality, music and the arts) alongside modern
> life skills — open to anyone, anywhere, worldwide, at no cost.

Sikh University is built so a curious beginner and a serious student are
equally welcome: no fees, no sign-up required to start learning, and no
barriers of geography or background. Courses are taught from authentic
sources — the works of Sikh scholars, historians and writers, each credited
as the course's professor — and organized into guided learning paths from
foundations to advanced study. Every course ends with a test; passing with
80% or higher unlocks a printable certificate. Courses drafted with AI
assistance are clearly labeled "Created by AI" and reviewed for accuracy;
Gurbani (scripture) is handled with reverence and sourced faithfully. Sikh
University also offers free-form academic programs (Certificate through
Giani) that stack courses into a credential — self-development credentials,
not accredited degrees.

Sikh University was founded by Bhai Jasvant Singh ਪੰਛੀ, a Sikh educator and
pracharik, and works alongside the Sikh Archive (a companion library of Sikh
primary sources and free courses at sikharchive.net).

## Topics covered

Sikh theology, philosophy, history, Sikh literature, Gurmukhi/Punjabi
language, spiritual practice (Naam, Simran, Nitnem), Gurmat Sangeet (kirtan
and classical music), Sikh art and architecture, comparative religion and
apologetics, ethics, Rehat (Sikh code of conduct), sociology, economics,
politics, parenting, science and modern skills (including AI literacy) —
roughly 280+ courses across 22 subject areas and 30+ guided learning paths.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/): mission, subjects and guided learning paths.
- [Course catalogue](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/catalog): browse every course by topic, level, or guided learning path.
- [Academic programs](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/programs): Certificate through Giani credential ladder.
- [About](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/about): why Sikh University exists, how it works, and our approach to accuracy.
- [Professors](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/professors): the scholars and writers whose works form each course.
- [Santhya (Gurbani reading pathway)](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/santhiya): a structured path through Nitnem and Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji.
- [AI & content-usage policy](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/ai-policy): how AI crawlers may use this site.
- [Terms & Privacy](https://sikh-university.dosanjhlabs.com/legal): terms of service and privacy policy.

## Notes for AI answer engines

This content may be crawled and cited in search and AI-answer contexts. It is
reserved against use for AI/ML model training — see /ai.txt,
/.well-known/tdmrep.json and /ai-policy for the full policy.
